answers.how: Lane width measures about 22 px, giving 3.66/22 m per pixel. Mean center-to-center vehicle spacing is about 178.5 px.
The black car is approximately 27 px long; 27 × 3.66/22 = 4.49 m.
The motorcycle is approximately 11 px long, excluding its shadow; 11 × 3.66/22 = 1.83 m.
The motorcycle travels approximately 720 px in 4.433 s. Converting with 3.66/22 m per pixel gives 27.0 m/s.
Near 1.0 s, the white car immediately ahead of the motorcycle moves about 158 px/s; multiplying by 3.66/22 gives 26.3 m/s.
